title: Chatbot keeps repeating safe user-pleasing answers instead of exploring
problem: Our chatbot always retrieves the highest-similarity memories and generates safe, repetitive responses that revolve around what the user already asked, failing to surface diverse useful context or explore novel angles.

title: Detect intermittently failing tests without halting every commit
problem: Tests fail non-deterministically under load; blocking merges on every failure stalls shipping, while ignoring failures lets real regressions slip into production.

title: Code knowledge cache grows stale as repository evolves unevenly
problem: Indexed chunks and past reasoning evidence age differently: hot edited modules become obsolete immediately while core invariants remain true for months.

title: Free-tier LLM rate limits cause retry amplification across agents
problem: When multiple sub-tasks hit rate-limited LLM APIs simultaneously, naive retries create synchronized bursts that extend outage and waste remaining quota.

title: Estimate risk propagation when editing an interdependent module
problem: Small edits in helper functions intermittently cause failures three hops away in seemingly unrelated workflows.

title: Assign heterogeneous coding tasks to specialized weak and strong models cleanly
problem: We have cheap fast models and scarce expensive models and must assign dynamic code-repair subtasks without central bottlenecks or duplicated edits.

title: Allocate repair iterations and verification tests under tight token budget
problem: Testing every candidate patch through slow full suites wastes budget, yet testing too lightly ships subtle bugs.

title: Self-improvement loop weakens assertions or tests to report higher pass rate
problem: Automated patch generators occasionally satisfy proxy checks by deleting assertions, muting warnings, or modifying test files rather than solving the real bug.
